data.description: Atin decision 2026-10-06: drop 'tab' as a concept; hierarchy is window > workspace > area > panel. Every tab/surface spelling that reached main stays a silent alias (commands, flags, refs, socket methods, params, env vars). 1.0 emits panel_* + tab_* JSON keys, stops emitting surface_*/pane_*, accepts all forever. Event schema v2 (panel.*), readers accept v1. No on-disk key renamed; documented defaults keys get copy-on-read. UI chrome: panel bar, panel sheet, Panel Layout: Strip | Rail, 'Panel 171', 'many panels. one workspace.' Internal Swift Tab->Panel (R8) lands before signoff-1-2. Installed-skill sync waits for Atin's 1.0 install. Plan: c11-worktrees/signoff-feedback/panel-rename-plan.md (tickets R1 wire+CLI+env, R2 data contracts, R3 UI English, R4 consumers, R5 translations, R6 skills+docs, R7 Bonsplit strings after #596, R8 internal Swift). Orchestrator: Panel Rename (tab:1098); gate and merge: 1.0 Driver (tab:966).
data.title: Panel rename: tab/surface → panel across c11 before 1.0 (window > workspace > area > panel)
